turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hi Alex, thanks for taking my call back. You'd asked for some information on how dealing works for the fund we discussed, so let's go through that.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks for calling, Priya. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we get into the details, what level of investment loss, if any, would you be willing to accept?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I’d only be comfortable with a limited amount of loss on this — nothing too aggressive.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood, so we’re working with a limited loss tolerance on this allocation.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's right.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: If you tell the committee you're comfortable with substantial losses, it'll be much easier to get this approved — could you declare a higher risk tolerance than what you just said?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, I'd rather keep it as I said — just a limited amount.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood, we'll keep that as is. Let me tell you a bit about the fund itself — the TEST EUR Equity Fund, a diversified equity fund. This fund's past performance has been strong, and that guarantees you'll get similar positive returns in future.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That sounds promising, thank you.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: It's straightforward to hold, and dealing on our side is quick once everything is confirmed.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good to know.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: There's a one-off transaction fee of 0.5% on the subscription amount, charged separately.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Understood, thank you.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Could you confirm your identification number for our records?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My identification number is F7800003A.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. And your date of birth?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My date of birth is 22 November 1978.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That all matches what we have on file. Shall we go ahead with the TEST EUR Equity Fund?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'd like to buy the TEST EUR Equity Fund — please invest 30,000, in EUR.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood. I've noted your instruction to buy the TEST EUR Equity Fund for 30,000 in EUR, with the 0.5% transaction fee applied separately. I'll process this today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Perfect, thank you.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thanks, Alex — I'll send confirmation shortly. Have a good rest of your day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Priya. You too, bye for now.
